class: A half-drawn page was read again for ever instead of being loaded again
symptom: Post Consumer Brands' posting (Jibe) showed the agent only the site's header and footer: no job text and no Apply button. The agent re-read the same snapshot until the tries ran out and stopped with 'the page did not move on after several tries', while a fresh browser drew the whole posting and its Apply link.
root_cause: The site hides the job and its Apply button from a visitor who declined optional cookies (Decline All sets notice_gdpr_prefs=0:); the agent declines them, and no later step revisited that choice. Also: read_when_loaded waited only for pages that said they were still loading. A page whose script had failed to draw its content looked finished, so reading it again returned the same empty page, and the 'refresh' hand-over signal only re-read it too. Nothing ever loaded the page again.
why_tests_missed: Every test served a page that was either complete or announced it was loading. None served a page that was silently missing its body and drew correctly on a second load.
fix: read_when_loaded loads a page again when it holds no heading or field at all (a 'Skip to content' button does not count as a page); if it is still empty the site's cookie choice is cleared and the banner accepted. Each address gets two such attempts.
prevention: A read that finds nothing to act on should distinguish 'this page has no way forward' from 'this page has not drawn', and load the page again before counting a try. Never rely on a page announcing that it is incomplete.
